mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 41 degrees near the Verona Public Library, all under the phase of a New Moon.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive and Rita Avenue reconstruction project. Work includes replacing water mains, sanitary and storm sewers, and adding new sidewalks and asphalt to improve local infrastructure.

Looking at the local calendar, we have Live Music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee all happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out Trivia Night at The Mill, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, or head to ART House 360.
In the weekly police report, an incident occurred on October 25 where a man was arrested for operating while intoxicated, or O W I, after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle at an intersection.
For dessert today, Culver's is serving up their Chocolate Caramel Twist flavor of the day. The store opens today at 10 AM, so stop by later to enjoy a scoop.
